sessionEnd.bash:
set -euo pipefail

tests_ran=0
if [ -f package.json ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  package_has_test="$(node -e 'const p=require("./package.json"); process.stdout.write(String(Boolean(p.scripts && p.scripts.test)));')"
  if [ "${package_has_test}" = "true" ]; then
    if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then
      pnpm test
    elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then
      yarn test
    elif [ -f bun.lockb ] || [ -f bun.lock ]; then
      bun test
    else
      npm test
    fi
    tests_ran=1
  fi
fi
if [ "${tests_ran}" -eq 0 ]; then
  if [ -f Cargo.toml ]; then
    cargo test
  elif [ -f go.mod ]; then
    go test ./...
  elif [ -f pyproject.toml ] || [ -f pytest.ini ] || [ -f tox.ini ]; then
    python -m pytest
  elif [ -d tests ] && find tests -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.bats' -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then
    bats tests
  elif [ -f Makefile ] && grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*test:' Makefile; then
    make test
  else
    printf '%s\n' 'No supported test command found; skipping session-end test hook.' >&2
  fi
fi
